basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering at Indian Institute of Technology Indore has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the research project "An Integrated Sensor-Based Data Logger for Microclimate Monitoring and Predictive Quality Modeling in Post-Harvest Storage", funded by AgriHub, IIT Indore. The appointment is initially for 1 year at Rs. 37,000 + HRA as per funding agency. rows.details: An Integrated Sensor-Based Data Logger for Microclimate Monitoring and Predictive Quality Modeling in Post-Harvest Storage
Initially for 1 year, may be extended as per institute and funding agency guidelines
Rs. 37,000 + HRA as per funding agency
32 years General, (+ 5 years SC, ST, OBC-NCL, PwD) as per rules
Detailed CV through a Google Form only

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Graduate/Postgraduate Degree in Mechanical Engineering/ Mechatronics/ Instrumentation/ Electronics and Communication Engineering and any other related branch. Desirable qualification and experience, as printed: First Class M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering/Mechatronics/Instrumentation/Electronics. Candidate with GATE in a relevant area. Worked in CFTI/research labs/industry with similar nature of work. PCB design and wireless communication (BLE/LoRa/mesh); low-power embedded systems; data analysis/ML (Python). Demonstrated device-prototyping experience (portfolio/publications/patents). Age limit: 32 years for General candidates, plus 5 years for SC, ST, OBC-NCL and PwD candidates, as per rules. The notice prints no date for counting age.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 + HRA as per funding agency. The appointment is initially for 1 year and may be extended as per institute and funding agency guidelines. The notice also says the selected candidate may be considered for admission to the PhD Programme as a regular full-time scholar at IIT Indore as per Institute norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The JRF will be responsible for project objectives such as the following, and other work assigned by the PI: Hardware Development Data Collection & Edge Analytics Modeling Predictive Platform

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Submit a detailed CV through the Google Form only: IIT Indore JRF application Google Form . Include complete academic grades/percentage starting from X standard onwards, with year of graduation, university or college, GATE score with year, discipline, marks, All India Rank, number of candidates who appeared, contact details and a valid email id. Include details of work experience in the project-relevant field. Submit before the last date, 5 December 2026. Incomplete applications will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email for the interview. The date of interview is 8 December 2026 (tentative). No TA/DA will be paid for the interview. The notice does not describe how shortlisting is done or what the interview covers.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted through the Google Form only. Incomplete applications will be rejected. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The interview date is tentative. Extension of the 1-year appointment depends on institute and funding agency guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there in the IIT Indore AgriHub project?
faq.answer: There is 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) vacancy in the Department of Mechanical Engineering project funded by AgriHub, IIT Indore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date of applications is 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Graduate/Postgraduate Degree in Mechanical Engineering/ Mechatronics/ Instrumentation/ Electronics and Communication Engineering and any other related branch. First Class M.E./M.Tech and GATE in a relevant area are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 32 years for General candidates, plus 5 years for SC, ST, OBC-NCL and PwD candidates, as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 + HRA as per funding agency.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: The notice states the fellowship as Rs. 37,000 + HRA as per funding agency, so HRA is mentioned alongside the amount. It prints no HRA amount.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Submit a detailed CV through the Google Form given in the notice only. The CV must include academic details from X standard onwards, GATE score with year, contact details, a valid email id and project-relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q8. When is the IIT Indore JRF interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 8 December 2026 (tentative). Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email, and no TA/DA will be paid.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the IIT Indore JRF appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for 1 year and may be extended as per institute and funding agency guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. Can the JRF join the PhD Programme at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: The selected candidate may be considered for admission to the PhD Programme as a regular full-time scholar at IIT Indore as per Institute norms.
